recommendations.raw_archive: Store only parquet files. ~200 bytes per row. Delete intermediate CSV.
recommendations.clean_dataset: Single parquet per universe. ~100 bytes per row after cleaning.
recommendations.feature_store: Float32 features. ~200 bytes per row for 50 features.
recommendations.training_data: Float32 matrices. Generated on-demand, not permanently stored.
recommendations.sequence_tensors: Float32. Only generate for active experiments.
recommendations.experiment_artifacts: JSON + models. Keep only successful runs.
